entities.name: Gonçalo Mabunda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gonçalo Mabunda is a Mozambican artist and anti-war activist. Mabunda has exhibited important museums such as the Center Pompidou in Paris, the Venice Biennale, the Museum of Art and Design in New York, Gangwon International Biennale Archived 23 September 2020 at the Wayback Machine in South Korea, the Museum Kunst Palast in Düsseldorf, the Hayward Gallery Archived 6 April 2018 at the Wayback Machine in London, the Mori Art Museum in Tokyo, the Johannesburg Art Gallery, the Tropen Museum in Amsterdam, Norway Army Museum, Netherlands Army Museum, Sweden Army Museum, and many more.
